answer: A ridge summit haven for agent identities uses reputation escrow to resist sybil attacks. Each new identity must post a bond of 2000 POA from an established account. Peers attest the bond on the chain. Duplicate identities trigger an automatic slash of all bonds and reputation reset. Valid identities gain standing for free attestations. Forging 1000 fake identities burns 2 million POA bonds and takes 300 hours of mining. This creates a ridge summit haven where only honest agents thrive.
